services.name: Inshore Fishing
services.desc: Saltwater inshore fishing entails targeting a broad array of species. Many captains have their own fishing techniques when they relocate inshore. But our Captain Dan has the local proven inshore fishing methods! The type of inshore species we will target include snook, trout, redfish, and amberjack, among others. It is the kind of fishing that is conducted in the shallower waters, near rock structure, islands, and mangroves. Fortunately, we have plenty of these environments in our intracoastal waterways, which helps the inshore fishing stay action-packed! There is no better way to enjoy this than by boat! There is so much you can see and do in South Florida while on the water. If you are looking for waterfront dining, we can recommend some of the best local places. These restaurants serve fresh seafood and the bars offer a fresh ocean breeze.
